schemes.title: Bhoomi — Karnataka RTC (Pahani) and Mutation
schemes.brief: Bhoomi holds the land record of every agricultural holding in Karnataka. The RTC, also called the pahani, shows who holds the land, how much, and what was sown. The i-RTC is a digitally signed copy that banks and offices accept, and mutation status after a sale or a death is tracked on the same site.
schemes.benefit: RTC and digitally signed i-RTC online, with mutation status and survey sketches
eligibility: Agricultural land situated in Karnataka and entered in the record of rights
Anyone may view an RTC; only the holder or a legal heir can apply for a mutation
A mutation on sale needs the registered deed; one on inheritance needs the death certificate and heirship papers
An i-RTC needs a mobile number, since it is delivered against an OTP
documents: Survey number and hissa number, or the owner's name
Aadhaar card, for an i-RTC or a mutation
Registered sale deed, for a mutation on purchase
Death certificate and family tree, for a mutation on inheritance

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: A free RTC view for your own reference, an i-RTC for a bank or an office, mutation status, or a Mojini survey sketch.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Pick all four from the lists. The record is held village by village.

demoFields.label: Survey Number
demoFields.hint: From the old RTC or the purchase deed.

demoFields.label: Surnoc / Hissa Number
demoFields.hint: The sub-division of the survey number. Copy it exactly — a wrong hissa pulls up a neighbour's land.

demoFields.label: Owner's Name as on the record
demoFields.hint: Spelt as on the land record, which may differ from Aadhaar. Search the record's spelling first and get a correction later if needed.

demoFields.label: Year / Period
demoFields.hint: The RTC is kept year by year. Take the current year unless an office has asked for an older one.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar and Mobile (for an i-RTC)
demoFields.hint: Needed for a digitally signed copy. The download link comes to this mobile against an OTP.

demoFields.label: Mutation (MR) number, to check status
demoFields.hint: Given when the mutation is filed. Track the stage against it rather than going to the office.

demoSteps: Open landrecords.karnataka.gov.in and view the RTC for your survey and hissa number. Check the extent, the owner's name and the crop entry against what you know. This view is free.
For a bank, a court or a subsidy claim, buy the i-RTC — the digitally signed copy. The free print is not accepted for those.
After a purchase or a death, file the mutation at the taluk office or through Nadakacheri with the registered deed, or the death certificate and family tree.
Keep the MR number and track the mutation stage on Bhoomi rather than waiting at the office.
The Revenue Inspector gives notice and hears any objection before the Tahsildar passes the order.
Once the order is passed, pull a fresh RTC and check that the name and extent are right. An error here is much easier to fix now than years later.
Keep a current RTC with your papers. Crop loans, PM-Kisan and state farm schemes all ask for it.
schemes.helpline: Your taluk office, or the nearest Nadakacheri centre

schemes.title: KPSC Recruitment — KAS, FDA and SDA
schemes.brief: The Karnataka Public Service Commission recruits for the Karnataka Administrative Service and for Group A, B and C posts including First and Second Division Assistant and the engineering services. Notifications appear on the Commission's site and applications are filed on its online portal.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every KPSC recruitment, with admit cards and results
eligibility: Indian citizen; a Karnataka domicile for the reserved quotas and for posts with a local requirement
Age as the notification states, usually 21 to 35 for KAS, with relaxation for SC, ST, Category-1, OBC and disability
A degree from a recognised university, held on the closing date, for KAS and most Group A and B posts
Kannada language knowledge as the notification requires for several posts
Each notification sets its own conditions; read that one before you pay
documents: SSLC (Class 10) marks card for date of birth
Karnataka caste and income certificate, for a reserved category
Rural, Kannada medium or Hyderabad-Karnataka certificate, where claiming those quotas
Disability or ex-serviceman certificate, where claiming that reservation
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Post or examination applied for
demoFields.value: Gazetted Probationers (KAS) Group A and B
demoFields.hint: One application per notification. Check the qualification and the age limit in that notification before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on SSLC marks card)
demoFields.hint: The SSLC marks card governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ. Everything later is checked against it.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC marks card.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the SSLC marks card. Age limits count from this date and it cannot be changed after registration.

demoFields.label: Category and special quotas claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Karnataka certificate for. The rural and Kannada-medium quotas need separate certificates from your school and the taluk office.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the closing date, not merely expected.

demoFields.label: Kannada language knowledge
demoFields.value: Studied Kannada as first language up to SSLC
demoFields.hint: Several posts require it and test it. Declare it honestly and keep the school certificate.

demoFields.label: Examination centre preference
demoFields.hint: Give two or three. The Commission allots the nearest centre it can.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here. Do not use a cyber cafe's.

demoSteps: Watch kpsc.kar.nic.in for the notification and read the age, qualification and language conditions before anything else.
Register on kpsconline.karnataka.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the SSLC marks card, and upload the photograph and signature in the stated sizes.
Fill the application, claim only the quotas you hold certificates for, choose your centres and pay the fee online.
Use the correction window if the Commission opens one. It is the only chance to fix a wrong entry and it closes quickly.
Download the admit card about a week before each stage and take it with a photo ID.
KAS runs as a preliminary, a main examination and an interview. Results for each are published on the Commission's site.
Document verification comes last. Produce the originals of everything you claimed — a rural or Kannada-medium certificate you cannot produce there costs you the post.

schemes.title: Kaveri Online Services — Registration, EC and Marriage
schemes.department: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka
schemes.brief: Kaveri is where property is registered in Karnataka. You do the data entry and pay the stamp duty online, then keep one appointment at the Sub-Registrar's office. The encumbrance certificate, a certified copy of a deed and marriage registration are on the same portal.
schemes.benefit: Online property registration with a booked slot, plus EC, certified copies and marriage registration
eligibility: Property situated in Karnataka, for registration, an EC or a certified copy
Both parties present at the Sub-Registrar's office on the appointment date, with two witnesses
For marriage registration, both parties of legal age with proof of the marriage having taken place
A mobile number and email, since the slot and every notice go there
documents: Aadhaar cards of both parties and of the two witnesses
PAN cards of both parties, for a property transaction
Draft of the deed to be registered
Latest khata certificate, tax paid receipt and the earlier title deed
Encumbrance certificate for the past thirteen years
Marriage invitation, photographs and a priest's or registrar's certificate, for marriage registration

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Property registration, EC, certified copy of a deed, or marriage registration. Each has its own form and fee.

demoFields.label: District / Taluk / Hobli / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the property lies. The EC is searched against the Sub-Registrar's office for that area.

demoFields.label: Property identification
demoFields.hint: Survey and hissa number for agricultural land, or the site and khata number for a site. Copy it from the title deed.

demoFields.label: Period for which the EC is wanted
demoFields.hint: Banks usually ask for thirteen years. Ask for a longer period if the title has changed hands often.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name and Aadhaar
demoFields.hint: As on Aadhaar. The certificate is issued in this name.

demoFields.label: Owner's name as on the records
demoFields.hint: The EC is searched against the name in the registered documents, which may not match Aadhaar exactly.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number and the download link come here.

demoSteps: Register on kaveri.karnataka.gov.in with your mobile and email, and choose the service you need.
For an EC, enter the district, the Sub-Registrar's office, the property details and the period, pay the fee online and download the certificate when it is ready.
For a property registration, do the data entry on the portal, work out the stamp duty and registration fee with the calculator, and pay online.
Book the Sub-Registrar appointment slot on the portal. This is what saves the day of waiting — the slot is a fixed time, not a queue token.
Attend on the date with both parties, two witnesses and the originals of every document. Photographs and thumb impressions are taken there.
The registered deed is scanned and returned, and the certified copy can be downloaded from the portal afterwards.
Pull a fresh EC a few weeks later and check that the registration shows on it. That is the proof the record has actually been updated.
schemes.helpline: 080-22220192 — Department of Stamps and Registration, Karnataka
